children.text: 1b: Travel Plans & Reunion
children.cn: 1b: 电话交谈与重逢期待

children.text: Greeting & Guide Invitation
children.cn: 热情问候与向导邀请

children.speaker: Li Rui
children.text: Hello, George.
children.cn: 你好，乔治。
children.notes: 电话问候语。
children.statement: 这是李蕊在电话中向乔治打招呼。
children.explanation: Hello 是最常用的问候语。

children.speaker: George
children.text: Hi, Li Rui.
children.cn: 嗨，李蕊。
children.notes: 熟人之间的简短问候。
children.statement: Hi 是非正式的日常问候表达。
children.explanation: Hi 用于熟人朋友之间打招呼。

children.speaker: George
children.text: Guess what!
children.cn: 你猜怎么着！
children.notes: 常用口语短语，引出令人兴奋或意外的消息。
children.statement: Guess what 常用于引出令人期待的新消息。
children.explanation: 口语中用于吸引对方注意。

children.speaker: George
children.text: My father, Bob, and I are going to visit your hometown.
children.cn: 我爸爸鲍勃和我打算去你的家乡参观。
children.notes: be going to 表示计划打算；Bob 做 father 的同位语。
children.statement: 句中 are going to 表示将来打算做某事。
children.explanation: be going to do 表达计划与意图。

children.speaker: George
children.text: Could you be our guide?
children.cn: 你能当我们的向导吗？
children.notes: Could you...? 表示客气的请求；guide 表示向导。
children.statement: Could you 表达委婉客气的请求语气。
children.explanation: 情态动词 could 使请求更具礼貌。

children.speaker: Li Rui
children.text: Sure!
children.cn: 当然可以！
children.notes: 表示爽快答应对方的请求。
children.statement: Sure 表示欣然同意请求。
children.explanation: Sure 相当于 Of course / Certainly。

children.speaker: Li Rui
children.text: I'd love to!
children.cn: 我很乐意！
children.notes: I'd love to = I would love to，表示非常乐意。
children.statement: I'd love to 表示非常乐意做某事。
children.explanation: would love to 表达强烈的意愿。

children.text: 20-Year Friendship & Reunion
children.cn: 二十年挚友情谊与期待

children.speaker: George
children.text: Wonderful!
children.cn: 太棒了！
children.notes: 感叹词，表达高兴与满意。
children.statement: Wonderful 是感叹词，意为‘太好了’。
children.explanation: 表达由衷的赞叹。

children.speaker: George
children.text: You know, my father's last visit was about 20 years ago.
children.cn: 你知道的，我爸爸上一次来参观大概是20年前了。
children.notes: ago 用于一般过去时；last visit 做主语。
children.statement: 句子用一般过去时描述20年前的事件。
children.explanation: 20 years ago 标志着一般过去时。

children.speaker: George
children.text: He became a good friend of your grandfather.
children.cn: 他和你爷爷成了好朋友。
children.notes: become-became 过去式；a friend of your grandfather 双重所有格。
children.statement: 句中 a friend of your grandfather 运用了双重所有格结构。
children.explanation: of + 名词所有格构成双重所有格。

children.speaker: Li Rui
children.text: Grandpa will be so happy.
children.cn: 爷爷一定会非常高兴的。
children.notes: 一般将来时 will be；so 表示程度如此。
children.statement: will be 表示预见将来会产生的状态。
children.explanation: 一般将来时推测将来的反应。

children.speaker: Li Rui
children.text: They haven't seen each other for ages!
children.cn: 他们已经好多年没见过面了！
children.notes: 现在完成时 have not seen；for ages 意为‘好久，长年’。
children.statement: for ages 是现在完成时的常见时间状语。
children.explanation: for ages 表达持续很长一段时间。

children.speaker: George
children.text: Yes, and my father really wants to see how the place has changed since he last visited.
children.cn: 是的，我爸爸真的很想看看自从他上次访问以来这个地方发生了怎样的变化。
children.notes: since 引导时间状语从句（过去时），主句用现在完成时 has changed。
children.statement: since 引导的从句用一般过去时，主句动作持续至今用现在完成时。
children.explanation: since 从句表过去时间起点，主句用完成时。

children.text: 1c: Touring the Changing Hometown
children.cn: 1c: 实地探访家乡新貌

children.text: Trip Impression & Faster Journey
children.cn: 出行用时大幅缩减

children.speaker: Li Rui
children.text: What do you think of your trip so far?
children.cn: 到目前为止你觉得这次旅行怎么样？
children.notes: What do you think of...? 询问看法；so far 迄今为止。
children.statement: so far 表示‘迄今为止，到目前为止’。
children.explanation: so far 是常用短语，意为迄今为止。

children.speaker: Bob
children.text: Amazing!
children.cn: 太令人惊喜了！
children.notes: 形容词，令人惊叹的。
children.statement: Amazing 用于形容事物令人叹为观止。
children.explanation: 用于表达惊叹之情。

children.speaker: Bob
children.text: When I first visited here, it took half a day to reach the town.
children.cn: 我第一次来这里时，要花半天时间才能到达镇上。
children.notes: It took sb some time to do sth 句型；half a day 半天。
children.statement: it took time to reach 结构表示做某事花费时间。
children.explanation: take 表示耗费时间。
children.keywords: first visited, half a day, reach

children.speaker: Bob
children.text: Now, with the new roads, it takes only an hour.
children.cn: 现在有了新路，只需要一个小时。
children.notes: with 介词表伴随/凭借；takes only an hour 强调时间大大缩短。
children.statement: with the new roads 介词短语作状语，表示由于新修了道路。
children.explanation: with 表达伴随与原因条件。

children.text: School Commute & Easier Life
children.cn: 求学交通与生活便利

children.speaker: Li Rui
children.text: Yes.
children.cn: 是的。
children.notes: 赞同对方的说法。
children.statement: Yes 表示肯定赞同。
children.explanation: 日常赞同语。

children.speaker: Li Rui
children.text: When I was a child, the bus took nearly 40 minutes over rough roads to get to school.
children.cn: 我小时候，公共汽车在崎岖不平的路上要开将近40分钟才能到学校。
children.notes: rough 崎岖的；nearly 将近；over 在……之上穿行。
children.statement: rough 在句中指路面崎岖不平、路况极差。
children.explanation: rough roads 意为崎岖坎坷的道路。

children.speaker: Li Rui
children.text: Now, it takes only 15 minutes.
children.cn: 现在，只需要15分钟。
children.notes: takes only 15 minutes 形成鲜明速度对比。
children.statement: 行程时间从近40分钟大幅缩短至15分钟。
children.explanation: 体现了路网建设带来的生活便利。

children.speaker: George
children.text: Life is much easier!
children.cn: 生活方便多了！
children.notes: much 修饰比较级 easier，表示‘……得多’。
children.statement: much 可以用来修饰形容词比较级以加强程度。
children.explanation: much easier 意为轻松容易得多。

children.text: Healthcare & Shopping Facilities
children.cn: 就医与购物设施提升

children.speaker: Li Rui
children.text: Not only that.
children.cn: 不仅如此。
children.notes: 承上启下，引出更多的变化事实。
children.statement: Not only that 用于引出进一步的重要信息。
children.explanation: 过渡短语，意为‘不仅限于此’。

children.speaker: Li Rui
children.text: We used to have to travel far to see a doctor, but now our town has built a new hospital.
children.cn: 我们过去看病得走很远的路，但现在我们镇建了一家新医院。
children.notes: used to 过去常常；see a doctor 看医生；has built 现在完成时。
children.statement: used to have to 表达过去不得不做某事。
children.explanation: used to 强调过去与现在的对照。
children.keywords: used to, travel far, see a doctor, new hospital
children.highlight: used to, but now, has built

children.speaker: Bob
children.text: Great!
children.cn: 太好了！
children.notes: 赞美与感叹。
children.statement: Great 表示称赞与高兴。
children.explanation: 赞扬新医院的建设。

children.speaker: Bob
children.text: And didn't I see a supermarket down the street?
children.cn: 而且我刚才不是看到街尾有一家超市吗？
children.notes: 否定疑问句 didn't I see 表达期待肯定的确认语气。
children.statement: didn't I see 是否定疑问句形式，用于核实自己的观察。
children.explanation: 否定疑问句常表示反问或确信。

children.speaker: Li Rui
children.text: Yes.
children.cn: 是的。
children.notes: 确认对方看到的是事实。
children.statement: 李蕊确认镇上确实新开了超市。
children.explanation: Yes 回答肯定事实。

children.speaker: Li Rui
children.text: We didn't have any such places for shopping until 10 years ago.
children.cn: 直到10年前我们才有了这样的购物场所。
children.notes: not... until 直到……才；such places 这样的地方。
children.statement: not... until 结构表示直到某时才发生某事。
children.explanation: 直到十年前镇上才有了购物超市。
children.keywords: places for shopping, until 10 years ago

children.text: Ecological Transformation of the Hills
children.cn: 荒山变绿洲的生态奇迹

children.speaker: Bob
children.text: But the biggest change is on the hills.
children.cn: 但最大的变化是在山丘上。
children.notes: the biggest change 最高级；on the hills 在山丘上。
children.statement: Bob 认为最显著的改变体现在山地的绿化上。
children.explanation: the biggest change 表明生态变化最为震撼。

children.speaker: Bob
children.text: They used to be covered with sand.
children.cn: 它们过去到处被黄沙覆盖。
children.notes: be covered with 被……覆盖；used to be 过去曾经是。
children.statement: be covered with 意思是‘被……覆盖’。
children.explanation: 过去山丘常年荒芜多沙。
children.keywords: used to be, covered with, sand

children.speaker: Li Rui
children.text: And now they have been covered with beautiful trees!
children.cn: 而现在它们都被美丽的树木覆盖了！
children.notes: have been covered with 现在完成时的被动语态。
children.statement: have been covered with 是现在完成时的被动语态结构。
children.explanation: 表示生态治理成果持续至今并呈现绿意。
children.highlight: And now, have been covered with

children.text: Desert Environment & Past Hardships
children.cn: 昔日沙暴与农田缩减

children.text: Green Transformation & Corn Fields
children.cn: 惊叹绿化与广袤玉米地

children.speaker: Bob
children.text: I'm amazed by how green your hometown has become!
children.cn: 你们家乡变得如此绿意盎然，真让我惊叹！
children.notes: be amazed by 对……感到惊叹；how green... 感叹宾语从句。
children.statement: be amazed by 表示对某事感到十分惊奇和钦佩。
children.explanation: Bob 惊叹于眼前郁郁葱葱的生态新貌。

children.speaker: Grandpa
children.text: Have you seen the corn fields outside of the town yet?
children.cn: 你去看过镇外的玉米田了吗？
children.notes: 现在完成时疑问句；yet 用于完成时疑问句末尾，意为‘已经’。
children.statement: yet 常用于现在完成时的否定句或疑问句句末。
children.explanation: 询问是否已经参观了玉米地。

children.speaker: Bob
children.text: Yeah!
children.cn: 看到了！
children.notes: 口语中表示肯定回答 Yes。
children.statement: Yeah 是口语中对 Yes 的非正式替代。
children.explanation: 表达看到了玉米田。

children.speaker: Bob
children.text: They're huge!
children.cn: 它们面积太大了！
children.notes: huge 巨大的，广阔的。
children.statement: huge 表示规模极为庞大。
children.explanation: 形容玉米田一望无际。

children.text: Frequent Sandstorms & Shrinking Land
children.cn: 频发沙暴与治沙决心

children.speaker: Grandpa
children.text: There used to be sandstorms all the time, and the fields were getting smaller and smaller.
children.cn: 过去经常发生沙尘暴，田地也变得越来越小。
children.notes: all the time 一直；smaller and smaller 越来越小（比较级+and+比较级）。
children.statement: smaller and smaller 结构表示‘越来越小’。
children.explanation: 比较级+and+比较级表示程度逐步加深。
children.highlight: used to, all the time, smaller and smaller

children.speaker: Grandpa
children.text: Then, after one big sandstorm, we decided to do something.
children.cn: 后来，在一次大沙尘暴之后，我们决定采取行动。
children.notes: decide to do sth 决定做某事；do something 采取措施。
children.statement: decide 后面接动词不定式 to do 作为宾语。
children.explanation: decide to do 是固定搭配。

children.text: Action: Plant Selection & Government Support
children.cn: 科学选种与政民携手

children.text: Finding the Deep-Rooted Bush
children.cn: 发现深根固沙灌木

children.speaker: Bob
children.text: What did you do?
children.cn: 你们是怎么做的？
children.notes: 一般过去时特殊疑问句，询问具体行动。
children.statement: 句中助动词 did 辅助构成过去时疑问句。
children.explanation: 询问过去采取的治理措施。

children.speaker: Grandpa
children.text: We found a small bush.
children.cn: 我们找到了一种小灌木。
children.notes: bush 灌木；found 是 find 的过去式。
children.statement: bush 指低矮丛生的灌木植物。
children.explanation: 灌木适应沙地生长。

children.speaker: Grandpa
children.text: It had long roots that could hold the soil together.
children.cn: 它有很长的根系，能把土壤紧紧固定在一起。
children.notes: that 引导定语从句修饰 roots；hold... together 固持土壤。
children.statement: that 引导限制性定语从句，并在从句中作主语。
children.explanation: 定语从句修饰先行词 long roots。

children.text: Sandy Planting & State Support
children.cn: 沙地栽植与政府扶持

children.speaker: Grandpa
children.text: We began planting it in sandy areas.
children.cn: 我们开始在沙质区域种植它。
children.notes: begin doing/to do sth 开始做某事；sandy 多沙的。
children.statement: sandy 是名词 sand 加后缀 -y 构成的形容词。
children.explanation: sandy areas 指沙化土地。

children.speaker: Grandpa
children.text: The government provided support too.
children.cn: 政府也给予了大力支持。
children.notes: government 政府；provide support 提供支持。
children.statement: support 在句中作为不可数名词，意为‘支持’。
children.explanation: 政府提供技术、政策和物资支持。

children.text: Evolution: From Manual Work to Modern Prosperity
children.cn: 从手工拓荒到富裕幸福

children.text: Manual Labor to Mechanization
children.cn: 从人工劳作到机械助力

children.speaker: Bob
children.text: Wasn't it difficult to plant so many bushes?
children.cn: 种植这么多灌木难道不困难吗？
children.notes: 否定疑问句表示反问；it 是形式主语，to plant... 是真正主语。
children.statement: It was difficult to do sth 中 it 是形式主语。
children.explanation: 真正的主语是不定式短语 to plant...

children.speaker: Grandpa
children.text: Yes, it was.
children.cn: 是的，确实很艰难。
children.notes: 对否定疑问句的肯定回答，表示事实确实很困难。
children.statement: 英语中依据事实回答，确实困难则用 Yes, it was.
children.explanation: 符合英语否定疑问句的回答规则。

children.speaker: Grandpa
children.text: In the beginning, we worked by hand.
children.cn: 起初，我们全靠手工劳作。
children.notes: in the beginning 起初，一开始；by hand 用手工。
children.statement: by hand 介词短语表示‘纯手工，用手’。
children.explanation: 初期没有机械，只能靠双手植树。
children.keywords: In the beginning, worked by hand

children.speaker: Grandpa
children.text: Later, we had machines to help.
children.cn: 后来，我们有了机器来帮忙。
children.notes: to help 动词不定式作定语修饰 machines。
children.statement: Later 表示时间推移，‘后来’。
children.explanation: 引入现代化机械设备大幅提升了治沙效率。

children.text: Environmental Turnaround & Happy Lives
children.cn: 生态好转与幸福富裕

children.speaker: Grandpa
children.text: We have planted many bushes and trees since then.
children.cn: 从那以后，我们种植了大量的灌木和树木。
children.notes: since then 从那时起（常与现在完成时连用）；have planted 现在完成时。
children.statement: since then 是现在完成时的经典标志词。
children.explanation: 动作从过去持续到现在并有累积成果。

children.speaker: Grandpa
children.text: There are fewer sandstorms now and the environment is getting better.
children.cn: 现在沙尘暴减少了，环境也越来越好。
children.notes: fewer 修饰可数名词复数 sandstorms；getting better 渐进好转。
children.statement: fewer 是 few 的比较级，用于修饰可数名词复数。
children.explanation: sandstorms 是可数名词，因此用 fewer。

children.speaker: Grandpa
children.text: It has also improved our lives.
children.cn: 这同时也改善了我们的生活。
children.notes: improve 改善，提高；has improved 现在完成时。
children.statement: 生态改善对人们的生活带来了直接提升。
children.explanation: 环境治理与人民福祉密切相连。

children.speaker: Grandpa
children.text: Everyone has become richer and happier.
children.cn: 大家都变得更加富裕、更加幸福了。
children.notes: Everyone 作主语谓语用单数 has become；richer and happier 双重比较级并列。
children.statement: Everyone 做主语时，谓语动词需用单数形式 has。
children.explanation: 复合不定代词作主语通常视为单数。

children.text: Demographic Shift & Modern Farming
children.cn: 青年返乡与智慧大棚

children.text: Youth Returning to Hometown
children.cn: 年轻人回乡安居乐业

children.speaker: Reporter
children.text: How has life changed in your hometown over the last 20 years?
children.cn: 在过去的20年里，你们家乡的生活发生了怎样的变化？
children.notes: over the last 20 years 在过去20年间（现在完成时时间状语）。
children.statement: over the last 20 years 常与现在完成时连用。
children.explanation: 表示一段时间内持续发生的变化。
children.highlight: How has, over the last 20 years

children.speaker: Mr Yan
children.text: Oh, it has changed quite a lot!
children.cn: 噢，变化可太大了！
children.notes: quite a lot 相当多，非常大。
children.statement: quite a lot 在句中作状语，修饰动词 changed。
children.explanation: 表示变化幅度非常巨大。

children.speaker: Mr Yan
children.text: Many young people used to work in big cities.
children.cn: 许多年轻人过去常常在大城市打工。
children.notes: used to work 过去常常工作（现在已不这样）。
children.statement: used to 结构强调过去与现在的习惯对比。
children.explanation: 以前年轻人大多外出务工。
children.keywords: young people, used to work, big cities

children.speaker: Mr Yan
children.text: Now, more of them have come back to live and work here.
children.cn: 现在，他们中越来越多的人回到这里生活和工作。
children.notes: have come back 现在完成时；live and work 并列动词不定式。
children.statement: come back to do sth 表示回到某地做某事。
children.explanation: 家乡发展吸引青年人才返乡创业就业。
children.keywords: come back, live and work, here

children.speaker: Reporter
children.text: Great!
children.cn: 太好了！
children.notes: 称赞这一积极趋势。
children.statement: Great 表示记者的认可与赞许。
children.explanation: 感叹词表达赞赏。

children.text: Modern High-Tech Greenhouses
children.cn: 高科技大棚与蔬果规模化

children.speaker: Reporter
children.text: Have there been any other changes?
children.cn: 还有其他方面的变化吗？
children.notes: there be 句型的现在完成时形式 Have there been...?
children.statement: Have there been 是 there be 句型的现在完成时疑问形式。
children.explanation: 用于询问某地是否存在其他变化。

children.speaker: Ms Wu
children.text: Yes, we've changed the way we farm.
children.cn: 是的，我们改变了耕作方式。
children.notes: the way we farm 定语从句修饰 the way，省略了 in which / that。
children.statement: the way 后面可以直接跟从句表示‘做某事的方式’。
children.explanation: way 后接定语从句可省略关系词。

children.speaker: Ms Wu
children.text: I used to grow a few vegetables on a small farm to sell at the local market.
children.cn: 我过去常常在小农场种点蔬菜，拿到当地集市去卖。
children.notes: a few 少数几个；to sell 不定式表目的；local market 本地集市。
children.statement: to sell at the local market 是动词不定式作目的状语。
children.explanation: 说明种菜的目的是在本地集市售卖。
children.keywords: grow vegetables, small farm, local market
children.highlight: used to, a few, to sell

children.speaker: Ms Wu
children.text: Now, I have large, high-tech greenhouses.
children.cn: 现在，我拥有大型高科技温室大棚。
children.notes: high-tech 高科技的；greenhouses 温室（复数）。
children.statement: high-tech 是 compound adjective（复合形容词）。
children.explanation: high + tech 组合成复合词。

children.speaker: Ms Wu
children.text: There, I grow tons of fruit and vegetables, and sell them in large cities.
children.cn: 在那里，我种植成吨的水果和蔬菜，并销往大城市。
children.notes: tons of 成吨的，大量的；and 连接并列谓语 grow 和 sell。
children.statement: tons of 常用作非正式表达，意为‘大量的，成吨的’。
children.explanation: 体现规模化生产与远距离销售能力。
children.keywords: tons of, fruit and vegetables, large cities

children.text: Transport Infrastructure & E-Commerce Boom
children.cn: 立体路网与电商文旅

children.text: Highway & Railway Connectivity
children.cn: 高速公路与铁路助力

children.speaker: Reporter
children.text: Wow, the new highway and railway must have helped a lot!
children.cn: 哇，新建的高速公路和铁路一定帮了大忙！
children.notes: must have helped 对过去事情的极有把握的推测（必定已经……）。
children.statement: must have done 表达对过去发生事情的肯定推测。
children.explanation: 推测新公路铁路带来的巨大助益。

children.speaker: Mr Yan
children.text: Oh, they have!
children.cn: 噢，确实如此！
children.notes: they have = they have helped a lot 省略句。
children.statement: they have 是简略回答，承接前一句的 must have helped。
children.explanation: 确认交通建设带来的实际帮助。

children.text: Tourism & Nationwide Online Sales
children.cn: 旅游景点与全国线上销售

children.speaker: Mr Yan
children.text: Our village has become a tourist attraction.
children.cn: 我们的村子已经变成了一个旅游景点。
children.notes: tourist attraction 旅游胜地，景点；has become 现在完成时。
children.statement: tourist attraction 意为‘旅游胜地，旅游景点’。
children.explanation: 村庄成为乡村旅游目的地。

children.speaker: Mr Yan
children.text: We can now sell local products to tourists.
children.cn: 我们现在可以把特产直接卖给游客。
children.notes: local products 当地特产；sell A to B 把A卖给B。
children.statement: sell sth to sb 表示‘将某物卖给某人’。
children.explanation: 乡村旅游带动了农产品就地消纳与增收。

children.speaker: Mr Yan
children.text: We also sell products online to people all over China.
children.cn: 我们还在网上把产品销售给全国各地的人们。
children.notes: sell online 线上销售；all over China 全国各地。
children.statement: all over China 意为‘全中国各地’。
children.explanation: 借助电商网络拓展全国市场。

children.text: Public Facilities & Socialist Village
children.cn: 民生设施与社会主义新农村

children.text: Housing & Public Infrastructure
children.cn: 住房改善与医院图书馆

children.speaker: Reporter
children.text: Have these changes greatly improved your lives?
children.cn: 这些变化极大地改善了你们的生活吗？
children.notes: greatly 副词修饰 improved；现在完成时一般疑问句。
children.statement: greatly 是程度副词，意为‘大大地，非常’。
children.explanation: 询问变化是否极大提升了生活水准。

children.speaker: Ms Wu
children.text: Yes!
children.cn: 是的！
children.notes: 热情肯定的回答。
children.statement: Yes 表达了强烈的肯定语气。
children.explanation: 生活水平确实发生了质的飞跃。

children.speaker: Ms Wu
children.text: We now have new houses.
children.cn: 我们现在住上了新房子。
children.notes: new houses 居住条件改善。
children.statement: 村民住房条件获得全面提升。
children.explanation: 住上了宽敞明亮的新房。

children.speaker: Ms Wu
children.text: And our village has just built a new hospital and a library.
children.cn: 而且我们村刚刚建起了一所新医院和一个图书馆。
children.notes: has just built 现在完成时；just 刚刚。
children.statement: just 与现在完成时连用，表示刚刚完成的动作。
children.explanation: 新建了医院和图书馆完善公共服务。
children.keywords: has just built, new hospital, library

children.text: Building a New Socialist Village
children.cn: 共建社会主义美好新农村

children.speaker: Reporter
children.text: Wonderful!
children.cn: 太精彩了！
children.notes: 称赞村庄取得的辉煌成果。
children.statement: Wonderful 是感叹词，用于赞美。
children.explanation: 表达记者的赞美之情。

children.speaker: Reporter
children.text: Together you are building a new socialist village.
children.cn: 你们大家正在齐心协力建设社会主义新农村。
children.notes: socialist 社会主义的；are building 现在进行时表示正在进行或开展的伟大事业。
children.statement: socialist village 意为‘社会主义新农村’。
children.explanation: 总结村民共同奋斗的美好图景。

children.text: Historical Travel Hardships
children.cn: 昔日群山阻隔出行维艰

children.text: Geography & Lack of Bridges
children.cn: 山河阻隔与泥径难行

children.text: In the past, it was difficult to travel in Guizhou.
children.cn: 在过去，在贵州出行是非常艰难的。
children.notes: In the past 过去；it was difficult to do sth 做某事很困难。
children.statement: In the past 标志着一般过去时。
children.explanation: 回顾历史交通状况，使用过去时。

children.text: In many places, there used to be no bridges to cross mountains and rivers, and most roads were just dirt tracks.
children.cn: 在许多地方，过去没有桥梁跨越崇山峻岭和大江大河，大多数道路不过是泥土小道。
children.notes: there used to be 过去曾经有（此处 no 表示没有）；dirt tracks 泥土小路。
children.statement: dirt tracks 意为‘未铺设路面的泥土路、泥径’。
children.explanation: 过去道路设施极其简陋。
children.keywords: no bridges, mountains, rivers, dirt tracks

children.text: Economic Bottleneck for Locals
children.cn: 产品难出与产业受困

children.text: This made it difficult for locals to bring products to the market or to develop industry.
children.cn: 这使得当地人很难把农产品运到市场上，也很难发展工业。
children.notes: make it difficult for sb to do sth 使得某人做某事变得困难（it 为形式宾语）。
children.statement: it 在句中作形式宾语，真正的宾语是不定式短语 to bring products...
children.explanation: make it + adj. + for sb to do 经典句型。
children.keywords: made it difficult, bring products, develop industry
children.highlight: made it difficult for, or to

children.text: Modern Infrastructure Construction
children.cn: 天堑变通途的工程奇迹

children.text: Thousands of Kilometres of Roadways
children.cn: 数千公里公路铁路网

children.text: Now great changes have taken place.
children.cn: 如今，巨大的变化已经发生。
children.notes: take place 发生（不及物短语，无被动语态）；have taken place 现在完成时。
children.statement: take place 表示‘发生’，通常不用被动语态。
children.explanation: take place 为不及物动词短语。

children.text: The government has built thousands of kilometres of highways, railways, and wide roads.
children.cn: 政府已经修建了数千公里的高速公路、铁路和宽阔的道路。
children.notes: thousands of 数以千计的；highways 高速公路；wide roads 宽阔大道。
children.statement: thousands of 意为‘数千计的，成千上万的’。
children.explanation: thousands 与 of 连用表示概数。
children.keywords: thousands of, highways, railways, wide roads

children.text: Bridges & Tunnels Breakthrough
children.cn: 穿山跨水桥隧互通

children.text: It has also built many bridges and tunnels.
children.cn: 还修建了众多的桥梁和隧道。
children.notes: tunnels 隧道；has also built 现在完成时并列补充。
children.statement: tunnels 在句中表示‘地下隧道、穿山隧道’。
children.explanation: 贵州被誉为世界桥梁与隧道博物馆。

children.text: Time Compression & Socioeconomic Boom
children.cn: 时空压缩与富裕幸福

children.text: Dramatic Reduction in Travel Time
children.cn: 旅程从一天缩短至几小时

children.text: A journey that used to take a day now takes only a few hours.
children.cn: 过去需要一整天的旅程，现在只需要几个小时。
children.notes: that used to take a day 定语从句修饰 a journey；now takes 形成对比。
children.statement: that 引导定语从句修饰先行词 A journey。
children.explanation: 定语从句明确旅途的前后用时对比。
children.keywords: journey, used to take, a day, few hours
children.highlight: that used to, now takes only

children.text: Prosperity & Improved Livelihoods
children.cn: 生活富足幸福感大幅提升

children.text: As a result, the lives of local people have improved.
children.cn: 结果，当地人的生活得到了极大改善。
children.notes: As a result 结果；have improved 现在完成时。
children.statement: As a result 是过渡短语，意为‘结果，因此’。
children.explanation: 引出交通改善带来的民生结果。

children.text: They are much richer and happier than they once were.
children.cn: 他们比从前更加富裕、更加幸福了。
children.notes: much richer and happier 比较级；than they once were 比他们曾经的时候。
children.statement: once 在从句中作状语，意为‘曾经，一度’。
children.explanation: 今昔对比体现幸福感倍增。
children.highlight: much richer, than they once were

children.text: Historical Backdrop & Modern Launch
children.cn: 百年老线与新铁路线开通

children.text: Launch of the 480km SGR
children.cn: 480公里新铁路通车

children.text: In 2017, the new 480-kilometre Mombasa-Nairobi railway was opened.
children.cn: 2017年，全长480公里的蒙巴萨—内罗毕新铁路正式开通。
children.notes: 480-kilometre 复合形容词；was opened 被动语态。
children.statement: 480-kilometre 中 kilometre 用单数形式作定语。
children.explanation: 数词+连字符+名词单数构成复合形容词。

children.text: Rough Roads & The 1901 Slow Train
children.cn: 1901年老铁路与十小时长途

children.text: Before then, the only transport links between Mombasa, Kenya's main port, and Nairobi, Kenya's capital, were rough roads and an old railway line completed in 1901.
children.cn: 在那之前，肯尼亚主要港口蒙巴萨与首都内罗毕之间唯一的交通联系是崎岖的道路和一条于1901年建成的老旧铁路。
children.notes: Kenya's main port 和 Kenya's capital 分别作同位语；completed in 1901 过去分词短语作后置定语。
children.statement: completed in 1901 是过去分词短语作后置定语修饰 an old railway line。
children.explanation: 过去分词短语表被动和完成修饰名词。
children.keywords: transport links, main port, capital, rough roads, old railway
children.highlight: Before then, between... and, completed in

children.text: The old trains were very slow.
children.cn: 老火车非常缓慢。
children.notes: very slow 描述老式列车的运行速度。
children.statement: 句子使用系表结构描述老火车的缺点。
children.explanation: 系动词 were + 形容词 slow。

children.text: It took 10 hours to get to Nairobi from Mombasa by train.
children.cn: 坐火车从蒙巴萨到内罗毕要花上10个小时。
children.notes: It took sb time to do sth 过去时结构；by train 乘火车。
children.statement: by train 表示交通方式‘乘火车’。
children.explanation: 过去单程耗时达十小时之久。
children.keywords: took 10 hours, Mombasa, Nairobi, by train
children.highlight: It took, to get to, from... by

children.text: Speed Revolution & Huge Passenger Volume
children.cn: 中国建造速度与客流激增

children.text: Travel Time Cut to 5-6 Hours
children.cn: 行程大幅缩短至5-6小时

children.text: However, the new railway, built with China's help, has already cut the travel time between Mombasa and Nairobi to about five to six hours for passengers.
children.cn: 然而，在中国帮助下修建的新铁路，已经将蒙巴萨和内罗毕之间的乘客出行时间缩减至约五到六个小时。
children.notes: built with China's help 过去分词短语作插入定语；cut... to... 削减至……
children.statement: built with China's help 是过去分词短语作后置定语。
children.explanation: 修饰 the new railway 并指明建设背景。
children.keywords: China's help, cut travel time, five to six hours
children.highlight: However, built with, has already cut... to

children.text: Over Two Million Annual Users
children.cn: 每年两百多万人便捷出行

children.text: Now, more than two million people use it every year.
children.cn: 现在，每年有两百多万人乘坐这条铁路。
children.notes: more than 超过；two million 两百万（million 不加 s）。
children.statement: more than two million 表示‘两百多万’。
children.explanation: 数词后 million 保持单数形式。
children.keywords: two million people, use it, every year

children.text: Multifaceted Benefits for Kenyans
children.cn: 广泛惠及民生：政商物流各界好评

children.text: Government Worker: Town Wealth
children.cn: 政府官员见证城镇富裕

children.text: Local Kenyans have benefited a lot from the new railway.
children.cn: 当地肯尼亚人从新铁路中获益良多。
children.notes: benefit from 从……中受益；have benefited 现在完成时。
children.statement: benefit from 是固定短语，意为‘从……中受益’。
children.explanation: 新铁路给沿线居民带来切身实惠。
children.keywords: Local Kenyans, benefited a lot, new railway

children.text: A government worker said, "I'm very happy with the new railway built by our Chinese friends."
children.cn: 一位政府工作人员说：“我对中国朋友修建的新铁路感到非常满意。”
children.notes: be happy with 对……感到满意；built by 过去分词作定语。
children.statement: be happy with 意为‘对……感到满意/高兴’。
children.explanation: 表达当地官员对中国建设者的由衷感激。
children.keywords: government worker, happy with, Chinese friends

children.text: "Many changes have taken place in the town over the last few years, and the people who live here have become rich."
children.cn: “在过去的几年里，小镇发生了许多变化，住在这里的人们已经富裕起来了。”
children.notes: who live here 定语从句修饰 the people；have become rich 现在完成时。
children.statement: who 引导定语从句，先行词是 the people。
children.explanation: 铁路带动城镇商业繁荣与民众致富。
children.keywords: changes taken place, people who live here, rich
children.highlight: over the last few years, and, who

children.text: Businessman: Punctual & Affordable Deals
children.cn: 商人高效按时达成交易

children.text: A businessman said, "My experience of using the train since 2017 has been good."
children.cn: 一位商人说：“自2017年以来，我乘坐这趟火车的体验一直非常好。”
children.notes: using the train 动名词作介词 of 的宾语；since 2017 自2017年以来。
children.statement: experience of doing sth 表示‘做某事的经验/体验’。
children.explanation: 商人对铁路的运营质量给予好评。

children.text: "It is very convenient and doesn't cost much money."
children.cn: “它非常方便，而且花钱也不多。”
children.notes: convenient 方便的；doesn't cost much 费用低廉性价比高。
children.statement: convenient 是形容词，意为‘方便的，便利的’。
children.explanation: 列车准点且票价亲民。

children.text: "I am able to get to places on time and make business deals with ease."
children.cn: “我能够按时到达各地，轻松做成生意。”
children.notes: be able to 能够；on time 按时；make business deals 做生意达成交易；with ease 轻易地，轻松地。
children.statement: with ease 是介词短语，相当于副词 easily，意为‘轻易地，毫不费力地’。
children.explanation: 极大地促进了商务考察与贸易往来。
children.keywords: on time, business deals, with ease
children.highlight: able to, on time, with ease

children.text: Supermarket Manager: Fresh Food Logistics
children.cn: 超市经理点赞新鲜食品冷链运输

children.text: The railway has also made the transport of food easier.
children.cn: 这条铁路还使食品运输变得更容易了。
children.notes: make + 宾语 + 宾补(形容词比较级) easier。
children.statement: easier 在句中作宾语补足语。
children.explanation: 形容词比较级作宾补说明食品运输变得更容易。

children.text: "It used to take hundreds of lorries to carry food between the two cities, but now it takes only two or three trains," said a supermarket manager.
children.cn: “过去运送两个城市之间的食物需要几百辆卡车，但现在只需要两三列火车，”一位超市经理说。
children.notes: hundreds of lorries 数百辆卡车；between the two cities 在两座城市之间。
children.statement: lorry 是英式英语中指‘卡车、货车’的词汇。
children.explanation: 铁路运力大幅替代了高耗能公路货运。
children.keywords: hundreds of lorries, two or three trains, supermarket manager
children.highlight: used to, hundreds of, but now, only

children.text: As a result, people now have more fresh food to eat.
children.cn: 结果，人们现在有了更多新鲜的食物可吃。
children.notes: As a result 结果；to eat 动词不定式作定语修饰 fresh food。
children.statement: to eat 是不定式短语作后置定语修饰 food。
children.explanation: 快速冷链物流保障了居民的新鲜食品供应。
children.keywords: As a result, fresh food to eat
children.highlight: As a result, now, more... to eat

children.text: Vision: South-South International Cooperation
children.cn: 中肯携手共筑美好世界

children.text: Building a Better World Together
children.cn: 跨越山海共建美好世界

children.text: Although China and Kenya are far away from each other, the railway shows how different countries can work together to build a better world.
children.cn: 尽管中国和肯尼亚相隔遥远，但这条铁路展示了不同国家如何能够携手合作，共同建设一个更美好的世界。
children.notes: Although 引导让步状语从句；far away from 远离；how 引导宾语从句；work together to do 合作做某事。
children.statement: Although 引导让步状语从句，主句不能再使用 but。
children.explanation: 英语中 although 与 but 不可同时出现在一个主从复合句中。
children.keywords: China and Kenya, far away, work together, build better world
children.highlight: Although, far away from, shows how, work together to

children.text: Desolate Wasteland in 1962
children.cn: 1962年拓荒起点：风沙与严寒

children.text: Family Relocation & Barren Soil
children.cn: 举家迁往风沙荒原

children.text: In 1962, Wang Shanghai moved with his family from their house in Chengde to the sandy lands of Saihanba.
children.cn: 1962年，王尚海带着家人从承德的家中搬到了塞罕坝的风沙之地。
children.notes: move from... to... 从……搬到……；sandy lands 多沙荒地。
children.statement: move with his family 表示‘举家搬迁’。
children.explanation: 初代塞罕坝人扎根荒原奉献青春。

children.text: There were few trees to hold the soil together, and there were often sandstorms.
children.cn: 那里几乎没有树木来固定土壤，而且经常发生沙尘暴。
children.notes: few 几乎没有（修饰可数名词）；to hold 不定式作定语；hold... together 固土。
children.statement: few 表示否定意义，意为‘几乎没有’。
children.explanation: few 修饰 trees 说明极度荒芜匮乏。
children.keywords: few trees, hold soil together, sandstorms

children.text: Freezing Climate & Extreme Hardship
children.cn: 零下严寒与艰苦生存

children.text: Temperatures were below freezing during the winter.
children.cn: 冬季的气温在冰点以下。
children.notes: below freezing 冰点以下，零度以下；during the winter 在冬季期间。
children.statement: below freezing 表示气温在零摄氏度以下。
children.explanation: 塞罕坝冬季高寒，气候极端恶劣。

children.text: Life there was very difficult.
children.cn: 那里的生活极其艰苦。
children.notes: Life there 那里的生活（there 作后置定语）；difficult 艰苦困难的。
children.statement: there 在句中作后置定语修饰名词 Life。
children.explanation: 直截了当点明条件之艰苦。

children.text: 60 Years of Dedicated Afforestation
children.cn: 六十年坚守奉献与筑起林海

children.text: 369 Foresters Led by Wang Shanghai
children.cn: 王尚海率领369人英雄团队

children.text: With support from the government, Wang Shanghai led a group of 369 people who were determined to make the environment of Saihanba better.
children.cn: 在政府的支持下，王尚海带领着一支由369人组成的队伍，他们下定决心要改善塞罕坝的生态环境。
children.notes: led 是 lead 的过去式；be determined to do sth 下定决心做某事；who 引导定语从句。
children.statement: who were determined to... 是定语从句，修饰 369 people。
children.explanation: 定语从句说明这批建设者的坚定意志。
children.highlight: With support from, led, who were determined to

children.text: World's Largest Man-Made Forest
children.cn: 造就世界最大人工林场

children.text: Over the next 60 years, workers planted bushes and trees, creating the world's biggest man-made forest.
children.cn: 在接下来的60年里，建设者们种植灌木和树木，创造了世界上最大的现代人工林。
children.notes: Over the next 60 years 在接下来的60年里；creating 现在分词短语作结果状语；man-made 人造的。
children.statement: creating the world's biggest... 是现在分词短语作结果状语。
children.explanation: 分词短语体现了六十年坚持不懈造林带来的辉煌结果。
children.keywords: next 60 years, planted, creating, biggest man-made forest

children.text: Triumph: The Green Miracle Today
children.cn: 绿水青山创造生态奇迹

children.text: International Recognition & Hard Work
children.cn: 艰苦奋斗赢得绿色奇迹美誉

children.text: Today, Saihanba is known as "the green miracle".
children.cn: 今天，塞罕坝被誉为“绿色奇迹”。
children.notes: be known as 被称为，作为……而闻名；miracle 奇迹。
children.statement: be known as 意为‘被公认为/被称为……’。
children.explanation: 塞罕坝林场获得联合国‘地球卫士奖’。

children.text: This is the result of hard work and people working together.
children.cn: 这是辛勤付出与众人齐心协力的结晶。
children.notes: the result of ……的结果；people working together 动名词复合结构作介词 of 的宾语。
children.statement: working together 在句中作名词 people 的后置修饰，构成动名词复合结构。
children.explanation: 强调团结奋斗是创造奇迹的根源。
children.keywords: result of, hard work, working together
children.highlight: This is the result of, and

children.text: Lush Forests & Crystal Waters
children.cn: 林海茫茫水清岸绿

children.text: Now, the land is covered with green trees and the water is clean and fresh.
children.cn: 现在，大地被绿树覆盖，水源清澈纯净。
children.notes: be covered with 被……覆盖；clean and fresh 清澈新鲜。
children.statement: be covered with 是固定短语，表示‘被……覆盖’。
children.explanation: 展现了塞罕坝水清树绿的生态现状。
children.keywords: covered with green trees, water, clean and fresh
children.highlight: Now, covered with, clean and fresh

tree.cn: 我的成长蜕变与不变的爱

children.text: School Journey: Walking vs Bus Commute
children.cn: 上学路线与出行方式变化

children.text: Primary School Days: Walking with Parents
children.cn: 小学时光：与父母近距离步行

children.text: Now that I am older, my life is different from when I was in primary school.
children.cn: 既然我已经长大了，我的生活与小学时大不相同。
children.notes: Now that 既然（引导原因状语从句）；be different from 与……不同。
children.statement: Now that 引导原因状语从句，意为‘既然，由于’。
children.explanation: 引出成长带来的生活变化。

children.text: For example, my primary school was near my home, so I used to walk to school with my parents.
children.cn: 例如，我的小学就在我家附近，所以过去我常常和父母一起步行上学。
children.notes: For example 例如；used to walk 过去常常步行；so 引导结果从句。
children.statement: For example 用于列举具体事例来支撑观点。
children.explanation: 以小学上学路程作为具体例证。
children.keywords: primary school, near home, used to walk, parents

children.text: Junior High School: Bus with Friends
children.cn: 初中生活：与同伴结伴乘公交

children.text: Now my junior high school is farther from home.
children.cn: 现在我的初中离家更远了。
children.notes: junior high school 初中；farther 比较级（距离上更远）。
children.statement: farther 是 far 的比较级，侧重物理空间距离上的‘更远’。
children.explanation: 初中距离比小学明显更远。
children.keywords: junior high school, farther from home

children.text: I take a bus every day with my friends.
children.cn: 我每天和朋友们一起乘公共汽车上学。
children.notes: take a bus 坐公交车；every day 每天（副词短语）。
children.statement: take a bus 意为‘乘坐公共汽车’。
children.explanation: 出行方式转为与同伴搭乘公交。
children.keywords: take a bus, every day, friends

children.text: Home Evolution: Moving & Grandma Joining
children.cn: 居住空间改善与三代同堂

children.text: Small Flat to Large Residence
children.cn: 从小公寓迁入宽敞大屋

children.text: My home has changed too.
children.cn: 我的家庭居住条件也发生了变化。
children.notes: too 也；has changed 现在完成时。
children.statement: too 用于肯定句句末，表示‘也’。
children.explanation: 过渡至家庭居住环境的改善。

children.text: My family used to live in a small flat, but now we have moved to a much larger one.
children.cn: 我们家过去住在一间狭小的公寓里，但现在我们搬进了一套大得多的房子。
children.notes: used to live 过去住在；flat 公寓（英式）；much larger 大得多（much 修饰比较级）；one 代指 flat。
children.statement: flat 在英式英语中指‘公寓、单元房’。
children.explanation: 居住空间显著扩大。
children.highlight: used to, but now, have moved to, much larger

children.text: Grandma's Comfort & Daily Companionship
children.cn: 奶奶的独立空间与朝夕相伴

children.text: My grandma lives with us now as well.
children.cn: 我奶奶现在也和我们住在一起。
children.notes: live with 与……同住；as well 也（常置于句末）。
children.statement: as well 常置于句末，相当于 too。
children.explanation: 房子变大后奶奶也搬来同住。
children.keywords: grandma, lives with us, as well

children.text: She has her own room and her own TV set.
children.cn: 她拥有属于自己的房间和专属的电视机。
children.notes: her own 属于她自己的；TV set 电视机。
children.statement: own 作形容词与形容词性物主代词连用，强调‘属于自己的’。
children.explanation: 奶奶拥有独立舒适的起居空间。

children.text: I am glad that I get to see her every day.
children.cn: 我很高兴每天都能见到她。
children.notes: be glad that... 宾语从句；get to do sth 得到做某事的机会。
children.statement: get to do sth 表达‘得以/有机会做某事’。
children.explanation: 表达与长辈朝夕相处的喜悦。
children.keywords: glad, get to see, every day

children.text: Study Evolution: Confidence & Teamwork
children.cn: 学习方式跃升与团队协作

children.text: Growing Confidence & Group Discussions
children.cn: 自信倍增与踊跃参与讨论

children.text: The way I study is also different.
children.cn: 我的学习方式也不同了。
children.notes: The way I study 主语+定语从句；is different 谓语表语。
children.statement: The way I study 表达‘我学习的方式’。
children.explanation: 由生活转向学业方式的探讨。

children.text: I have become more confident in my studies and often attend group discussions.
children.cn: 我对学业变得更加自信，并经常参加小组讨论。
children.notes: more confident 更加自信；attend 参加；group discussions 小组讨论。
children.statement: be confident in 在……方面充满自信。
children.explanation: 在学业与同伴互动中收获成长。
children.highlight: have become, more confident in, and

children.text: Enjoying Study & Shared Achievements
children.cn: 乐学同伴与共同成就感

children.text: I enjoy studying with my friends.
children.cn: 我很喜欢和朋友们一起学习。
children.notes: enjoy doing sth 喜欢做某事。
children.statement: enjoy 后面必须接动名词形式 doing 作宾语。
children.explanation: enjoy doing 是常用固定搭配。

children.text: It's amazing how much we have achieved together.
children.cn: 令人惊喜的是，我们共同取得了如此多的收获与成就。
children.notes: It's amazing 形式主语；how much 引导真正主语从句；have achieved 现在完成时。
children.statement: how much we have achieved 引导从句作真正的主语。
children.explanation: 赞叹团队合作带来的丰硕成果。
children.highlight: It's amazing how much, have achieved

children.text: Core Value: Constant Family Love
children.cn: 永恒不变的亲情与幸福

children.text: Unchanging Warmth & Happiness
children.cn: 全家共享的真挚爱与温暖

children.text: My life has changed in many ways, but one thing has stayed the same: the feeling of love and happiness shared by my family.
children.cn: 我的生活在很多方面都发生了改变，但有一点始终未变：那就是全家人共享的爱与幸福感。
children.notes: in many ways 在许多方面；stayed the same 保持不变；shared by 过去分词短语作后置定语修饰 love and happiness。
children.statement: shared by my family 是过去分词短语作后置定语。
children.explanation: 点睛之笔：升华主题，指出家庭之爱永恒不变。
children.keywords: changed in many ways, stayed the same, love and happiness
children.highlight: in many ways, but, stayed the same, shared by

tree.text: Love My Hometown, Build My Hometown

children.text: Introduction: Devotion Across Generations
children.cn: 引言：各行各业奉献家乡

children.text: Contributing & Growing with Hometown
children.cn: 扎根家乡与共同成长

children.text: With a deep love for their hometown, people of different ages and professions are contributing to its development and growing along with it.
children.cn: 怀着对家乡的深沉热爱，不同年龄和行业的人们正在为家乡的发展贡献力量，并与它共同成长。
children.notes: contribute to 为……做贡献；along with 随着……一起；professions 职业。
children.statement: contribute to 是常用固定短语，意为‘为……做贡献’。
children.explanation: 介词 to 后接名词 development。
children.keywords: deep love, hometown, contributing to, development

children.text: Today, let us explore three such stories.
children.cn: 今天，让我们一起走进三个这样的故事。
children.notes: let sb do sth 让某人做某事；such stories 这样的故事。
children.statement: let 后接省略 to 的动词不定式作宾补。
children.explanation: let us explore 中 explore 用动词原形。

children.text: Story 1: Liu Guanghui - The Watermelon Farmer
children.cn: 故事一：西瓜专家刘光辉

children.text: Dedication Under the Sun at Age 70
children.cn: 古稀之年躬耕田间科研

children.text: Liu Guanghui is an agricultural technology expert in watermelon farming.
children.cn: 刘光辉是一位西瓜种植领域的农业技术专家。
children.notes: agricultural technology 农业技术；expert 专家；in watermelon farming 在西瓜种植方面。
children.statement: expert in 结构表示‘在某领域的专家’。
children.explanation: 刘光辉致力于西瓜农业技术推广。

children.text: Although he is more than 70 years old, he still spends most of his days working in the sun on the farmland.
children.cn: 虽然他已经70多岁了，但他依然把大部分时间花在农田里顶着烈日劳作。
children.notes: Although 引导让步状语从句；spend time doing sth 花费时间做某事；in the sun 在阳光下。
children.statement: spend + 时间 + doing sth 结构中，动词必须用 -ing 形式。
children.explanation: spend most of his days working 符合该用法。
children.keywords: Although, 70 years old, spends days working, sun
children.highlight: Although, more than, spends... doing, in the sun

children.text: He wears a wide hat, and his skin is brown from the sun.
children.cn: 他戴着一顶宽边草帽，皮肤被太阳晒得黝黑。
children.notes: a wide hat 宽边帽；brown from the sun 因日晒而呈棕褐色。
children.statement: from the sun 介词短语表示皮肤黝黑的原因。
children.explanation: 生动刻画了老专家常年在田间劳作的朴实形象。
children.keywords: wide hat, skin brown, from sun

children.text: He loves farming and has spent his life researching ways to improve it.
children.cn: 他热爱农业，并倾尽一生钻研改进种植技术的方法。
children.notes: spend one's life doing sth 倾注一生做某事；ways to improve 改进的方法。
children.statement: ways to improve it 中不定式 to improve 作定语修饰 ways。
children.explanation: 表达老专家毕生献身农业科研的情怀。
children.keywords: loves farming, spent life, researching ways

children.text: Free Training & Billion-Yuan Economy
children.cn: 免费技术培训与十亿产业腾飞

children.text: On his days off, Guanghui provides local farmers with technical training and guidance for free.
children.cn: 在休息日，光辉还会免费为当地农民提供技术培训和指导。
children.notes: on days off 在休息日；provide sb with sth 为某人提供某物；for free 免费。
children.statement: provide sb with sth 意为‘为某人提供某物’。
children.explanation: 免费传授种植技术造福乡亲。
children.keywords: days off, provides farmers, technical training, for free
children.highlight: On his days off, provide... with, for free

children.text: With joint efforts of the government, farmers, and experts like him, the farming economy in the province has grown by more than one billion yuan over the years.
children.cn: 在政府、农民和像他这样的专家的共同努力下，该省的农业经济多年来增长了10亿多元。
children.notes: joint efforts 共同努力；grown by 增长了……（表示增量幅度）；over the years 多年以来。
children.statement: grow by 后的数字表示‘净增长的幅度/差额’。
children.explanation: grow by 表示增长幅度，grow to 表示增长到某个数值。
children.keywords: joint efforts, farming economy, grown by, one billion yuan
children.highlight: With joint efforts of, has grown by, over the years

children.text: Story 2: Jiang Hui - The Flower Live-streamer
children.cn: 故事二：鲜花电商创客江慧

children.text: Childhood Flower Talent & Return to Hometown
children.cn: 童年花艺天赋与大学返乡创业

children.text: Jiang Hui's friends and fellow villagers call her the "flower girl".
children.cn: 江慧的朋友和乡亲们都亲切地叫她“养花姑娘”。
children.notes: fellow villagers 同村村民；call sb + 称呼 称某人为……
children.statement: call her the flower girl 中 the flower girl 作宾语补足语。
children.explanation: 复合宾语结构说明乡亲对她的称呼。

children.text: When she was young, Hui often visited her aunt's flower field after school, where she learnt how to grow flowers.
children.cn: 小时候，慧放学后经常去姑姑的花田，在那里她学会了如何种花。
children.notes: where 引导非限制性定语从句修饰 flower field；how to grow flowers ‘疑问词+不定式’作宾语。
children.statement: where 引导非限制性定语从句修饰先行词 aunt's flower field。
children.explanation: where 在从句中作地点状语。
children.keywords: young, aunt's flower field, learnt how to grow flowers

children.text: She also showed great talent in putting different flowers together beautifully.
children.cn: 她在巧妙优雅地搭配各种花卉方面也展现出极高的天赋。
children.notes: show talent in (doing) sth 在……方面展现天赋；put together 组合搭配。
children.statement: 介词 in 后面接动名词 putting 作宾语。
children.explanation: show talent in doing sth 是固定搭配。

children.text: After graduating from university, Hui decided to return to her hometown and start her own flower business.
children.cn: 大学毕业后，慧毅然决定回到家乡，开创属于自己的花卉事业。
children.notes: graduating from 从……毕业；decided to return 决定返回；start one's own business 创业。
children.statement: after 在句中作介词，后接动名词 graduating 作宾语。
children.explanation: 大学毕业后返乡创业。
children.keywords: graduating from university, return to hometown, flower business
children.highlight: After graduating from, decided to, and

children.text: Online Sales, Persistence & Empowering Villagers
children.cn: 直播带货坚守不懈与带领乡亲致富

children.text: To promote sales, she started to sell her flowers online.
children.cn: 为了促进销售，她开始在网上售卖鲜花。
children.notes: To promote sales 动词不定式作目的状语；sell online 线上销售。
children.statement: To promote sales 置于句首作目的状语。
children.explanation: 说明开展线上直播电商的目的。

children.text: It was hard at first, but she didn't give up.
children.cn: 起初困难重重，但她并没有轻言放弃。
children.notes: at first 起初；give up 放弃；but 表转折。
children.statement: give up 是动副短语，意为‘放弃’。
children.explanation: 面对创业初期的艰辛展现了坚韧品格。
children.keywords: hard at first, didn't give up

children.text: She always patiently explained and offered practical advice to customers.
children.cn: 她总是耐心地向顾客讲解并提供实用的选购建议。
children.notes: patiently 耐心地（副词修饰动词）；practical advice 实用建议（advice 为不可数名词）。
children.statement: advice 在英语中通常是不可数名词，不能加复数 -s。
children.explanation: 以诚意和专业服务打动客户。

children.text: Gradually, her online shop became more popular.
children.cn: 渐渐地，她的网店越来越受欢迎。
children.notes: Gradually 逐渐地；became more popular 变得更受欢迎。
children.statement: Gradually 是副词，意为‘逐渐地，一步步地’。
children.explanation: 经过努力网店知名度逐步提高。

children.text: She also helped other villagers and taught them how to sell agricultural products online.
children.cn: 她还主动帮助其他村民，教会他们如何在网上销售农副产品。
children.notes: taught 是 teach 的过去式；teach sb how to do 教某人如何做某事；agricultural products 农产品。
children.statement: how to sell online 在句中充当 taught 的直接宾语。
children.explanation: 带领乡亲们一同开拓线上销路。
children.keywords: helped villagers, taught, sell agricultural products online

children.text: "Many people now know about the agricultural products from our town," Hui said with a big smile.
children.cn: “现在许多人都知道了我们镇的农特产品，”慧面带灿烂的微笑说道。
children.notes: know about 了解/知晓；with a big smile 带着灿烂微笑（伴随状语）。
children.statement: with a big smile 是介词短语作伴随状语。
children.explanation: 表达推广家乡特产的自豪感。
children.keywords: know about, agricultural products, big smile
children.highlight: know about, with a big smile

children.text: "This makes all the hard work worthwhile!"
children.cn: “这让所有的辛劳付出都变得无比值得！”
children.notes: make + 宾语 + worthwhile (形容词作宾补，意为‘值得的’)。
children.statement: worthwhile 是形容词，意为‘值得做的，值得花时间的’。
children.explanation: 辛苦付出转化为助农实效。

children.text: Story 3: Yuan Bailing - The Village Teacher
children.cn: 故事三：乡村筑梦教师袁百灵

children.text: Childhood Commute vs Modern Roads
children.cn: 求学路途今昔对比与基建飞跃

children.text: When Yuan Bailing was a little girl, it took her almost an hour to get to school each day, but she loved school so much that she never missed it.
children.cn: 在袁百灵还是个小女孩的时候，每天上学几乎要花她一个小时，但她是如此热爱学校，以至于从不旷课缺席。
children.notes: it took sb time to do sth; so... that... 如此……以至于……
children.statement: so... that... 引导结果状语从句，意为‘如此……以至于……’。
children.explanation: 克服漫长路途坚持每日求学。
children.keywords: little girl, took an hour, loved school, never missed
children.highlight: When, took... to, so... that, never

children.text: As she grew up, she witnessed how her village changed greatly over the years.
children.cn: 随着慢慢长大，她亲眼见证了这些年来村庄发生的翻天覆地的变化。
children.notes: As 随着（引导时间状语从句）；witnessed 亲眼见证；how 引导宾语从句。
children.statement: witness 是动词，意为‘目睹，亲眼见证’。
children.explanation: 见证了村庄基础设施的蜕变。
children.keywords: grew up, witnessed, village changed greatly

children.text: Better roads and bridges have been built.
children.cn: 更好更通畅的道路和桥梁已经修建完毕。
children.notes: have been built 现在完成时的被动语态；roads and bridges 并列主语。
children.statement: have been built 是现在完成时的被动语态形式。
children.explanation: 道路桥梁等基建全面通达。

children.text: Now it takes only ten minutes for children to get to school.
children.cn: 现在孩子们上学只需要短短十分钟。
children.notes: it takes sb time to do sth; only ten minutes 仅需十分钟。
children.statement: 通勤时间从近一小时骤降至十分钟。
children.explanation: 路网极大方便了农村学童求学。
children.keywords: takes only ten minutes, children, get to school

children.text: First University Graduate Returning as Teacher
children.cn: 首位大学毕业生返乡执教照亮未来

children.text: As the first person from her village to graduate from university, Bailing decided to return to her hometown to become a teacher.
children.cn: 作为村里第一个大学毕业生，百灵毅然决定回到家乡当一名教师。
children.notes: the first person to do sth 第一个做某事的人；graduate from 从……毕业；to become 不定式表目的。
children.statement: to graduate from university 是不定式短语作后置定语修饰 the first person。
children.explanation: 序数词修饰的名词常后接动词不定式作定语。
children.keywords: first person, graduate, return to hometown, become teacher
children.highlight: As the first... to, decided to, to become

children.text: She wanted to help more children get a good education and be part of her hometown's growth and development.
children.cn: 她希望帮助更多的孩子获得良好的教育，并投身于家乡的成长与发展之中。
children.notes: help sb (to) do 帮助某人做某事；get a good education 接受良好教育；be part of 成为……的一部分。
children.statement: be part of 意为‘参与其中，成为……的一份子’。
children.explanation: 投身乡村教育事业点亮孩子未来。
children.keywords: help children, good education, part of growth, development
children.highlight: wanted to, help... get, be part of

children.text: Though the area still needs further development, through the courage and hard work of its people—like Bailing—it has a bright future ahead.
children.cn: 尽管这个地区仍需要进一步的发展，但凭借像百灵这样乡亲们的勇气和辛勤劳作，它前方必将拥有一片光明灿烂的未来。
children.notes: Though 尽管（引导让步状语从句）；further development 进一步发展；through 凭借/通过；a bright future ahead 眼前光明的未来。
children.statement: Though 引导让步状语从句，意为‘虽然，尽管’。
children.explanation: 总结展望家乡在青年建设者奋斗下充满希望的未来。
children.keywords: needs further development, courage, hard work, bright future
children.highlight: Though, still, through, bright future ahead
